Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String

    Case 44: Set a = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 10, 100, 40): Set b = ws.Shapes.AddLine(20, 70, 120, 110)
    Case 45: Set a = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40): Set b = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 20, 70, 100, 40)
    Case 46: Set a = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 10, 100, 40): Set b = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 20, 70, 100, 40)
    Case 47: Set a = ws.Shapes.AddLine(10, 10, 110, 50): Set b = ws.Shapes.AddLine(20, 70, 120, 110)
    Case 48: Set a = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40): Set b = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 20, 70, 100, 40)
    End Select
    a.Name = "a": b.Name = "b"
    Set r = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("a", "b"))
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 5
        r.Line.EndArrowheadStyle = 2
    Case 6
        r.Line.BeginArrowheadLength = 3
    Case 7
        r.Line.BeginArrowheadWidth = 1
    Case 8
        a.Line.EndArrowheadStyle = 2
    Case 9
        b.Line.EndArrowheadStyle = 3
    Case 10
        r.Line.EndArrowheadStyle = 2
    Case 11
        r.Line.EndArrowheadStyle = 2
    Case 12
        r.Line.Pattern = 22
    Case 13
        r.Line.Pattern = 22
    Case 14
        a.Line.Pattern = 22
    Case 15
        r.Line.Pattern = 22: r.Line.BackColor.RGB = 255
    Case 16
        r.Line.BackColor.RGB = 255
    Case 17
        r.Line.InsetPen = msoTrue
    Case 18
        a.Line.InsetPen = msoTrue
    Case 19
        r.Fill.ForeColor.ObjectThemeColor = 6
    Case 20
        r.Line.ForeColor.ObjectThemeColor = 6
    Case 21
        a.Fill.ForeColor.ObjectThemeColor = 6
    Case 22
        r.Fill.ForeColor.Brightness = 0.4
    Case 23
        a.Fill.ForeColor.Brightness = 0.4
    Case 24
        r.Fill.ForeColor.TintAndShade = 0.4
    Case 25
        a.Fill.ForeColor.TintAndShade = 0.4
    Case 26
        r.Line.ForeColor.Brightness = 0.4
    Case 27
        r.Fill.ForeColor.SchemeColor = 3
    Case 28
        r.Fill.Patterned 22
    Case 29
        a.Fill.Patterned 22
    Case 30
        r.Fill.Patterned 22: r.Fill.BackColor.RGB = 255
    Case 31
        r.Fill.Patterned 22
    Case 32
        r.Fill.TwoColorGradient 1, 1
    Case 33
        a.Fill.TwoColorGradient 1, 1
    Case 34
        r.Fill.OneColorGradient 1, 1, 0.25
    Case 35
        r.Fill.PresetGradient 1, 1, 7
    Case 36
        a.Fill.TwoColorGradient 1, 1: b.Fill.TwoColorGradient 2, 1
    Case 37
        r.Fill.TwoColorGradient 1, 1: r.Fill.GradientAngle = 30
    Case 38
        r.Fill.TwoColorGradient 1, 1: r.Fill.RotateWithObject = msoFalse
    Case 39
        r.Fill.TwoColorGradient 1, 1: r.Fill.GradientStops.Insert 255, 0.5
    Case 40
        r.Fill.TwoColorGradient 1, 1
    Case 41
        r.Adjustments(1) = 0.3
    Case 42
        a.Adjustments(1) = 0.3
    Case 43
        r.Adjustments(1) = 0.3
    Case 44
        r.Adjustments(1) = 0.3
    Case 45
        r.Adjustments(1) = 0.3
    Case 46
        r.Adjustments.Item(1) = 0.3
    Case 47
        r.ConnectorFormat.Type = 2
    Case 48
        r.ConnectorFormat.Type = 2
    End Select
    s = "ok"
Measured:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = r.Line.BeginArrowheadStyle
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""

    Err.Clear

    v = b.Adjustments(1)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Measured
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 48
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
